Partial proportional odds family

Source: R/zfam-zz-robust.R
partial_odds.Rd

A cumulative link model whose thresholds depend on covariates: P(Y <= k) = F(theta_k + z' gamma_k - mu), where mu is the proportional (parallel) part of the main formula and nonparallel gives the covariates z with category specific effects. This is the nominal effects model of ordinal::clm(nominal = ) and the partial proportional odds model of Peterson and Harrell (1990). In regcomp() the family adds parameters d1, ..., d(K-1) (the threshold shifts z' gamma_k), each with the nonparallel formula unless given its own.

Usage

partial_odds(
  nonparallel,
  link = c("logit", "probit", "cloglog", "loglog", "cauchit")
)

Arguments

nonparallel

One sided formula of the covariates with category specific effects. A covariate should not also appear in the main formula.

link

"logit", "probit", "cloglog", "loglog" or "cauchit".

Value

A family object for regcomp().

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(400), z = rnorm(400))
eta <- 0.8 * d$x
u <- runif(400)
d$y <- factor(1 + (u > plogis(-1 - eta)) + (u > plogis(1 + 0.5 * d$z - eta)))
f <- regcomp(y ~ x, family = partial_odds(~ z), data = d)
coef(f)
#>        mu:x        d1:z        d2:z    cuts:1|2    cuts:2|3 
#>  0.86086728  0.07016505  0.66578264 -0.96785350  0.96581296
